title: Default Currency Select
description: Before a currency is deliberately chosen, the Billing page's invoice generator has to default to something sensible. Confirm it lands on USD and offers every currency SwiftCargo actually supports.
successCondition: On /billing, for a shipment with no invoice yet, the currency <select> defaults to "USD" on first render (before any interaction) and its options exactly match the five BILLING_CURRENCIES values: USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, INR.
hints: The select and "Generate Invoice" button only render for shipments that don't have an invoice yet — pick a fresh shipment or use a customer with an un-invoiced booking.
Read the select's value attribute directly rather than assuming from the first <option> tag order in the DOM.
